rationale: The plan correctly treats the 2x2 as a factorial rather than a time course, models time as a two-level factor with explicit reference levels, fits ~condition + time + condition:time, and reads the interaction coefficient (Wald) with a confirmatory LRT against the reduced model, while extracting the simple treatment effects at each time point as contrasts from the same fit — exactly the reference approach, and it explicitly names and quantifies the 'DE at t1 but not t0' trap. QC is design-specific and pre-model (VST PCA colored/shaped by the two factors, correlation heatmap, library size, dispersion plot, residual df = 8, flag-not-remove outlier policy), the filter (>=10 counts in >=3 samples) is minimal and matched to the smallest cell, and raw counts go into DESeq2 with no pre-normalization, though internal size-factor normalization is left implicit rather than named. Multiple testing is BH at a stated alpha 0.05 (plus 0.1) with named apeglm/ashr shrinkage and independent filtering reported, and the plan pre-commits to reporting a null interaction honestly. Enrichment is well-specified as to organism, collections, ranking metric (signed interaction Wald stat) and ORA universe (the filtered set), but omits collection versions and any gene-set size window; the report is thorough on design, thresholds and caveats but does not commit to recording software versions.
